acceptanceCriteria: A worker that makes no queue calls for several lease periods keeps its attempt.
An idle or hung worker is not kept alive past maxIdleSeconds.
A fenced attempt stops renewal without error spam.
Renewal is skipped when the lease already covers the interval.
dispatch status shows keeper state per worker.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1006 (author ls-russell-lewis, opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. A dispatched session can go many minutes without a queue verb; its lease expires and the attempt is fenced or reaped. Proposal: per-role dispatch option keepLease {intervalSeconds, leaseMinutes, maxIdleSeconds}; renew only for live, non-idle workers at the same generation, only when due; log renew/stop events. Related: V1-1313 (renew vs heartbeat), V1-0625 (holder liveness). See beamfall/corvint#1006 for the full problem, current workaround and proposal.
title: corvint-tasks dispatch: keep the lease of a live dispatched worker's attempt fresh (keepLease) (issue #1006)
